Aproximação RNAV autorizada

An instruction indicating that the aircraft is authorized to execute an RNAV approach.

Questions and answers

What is Aproximação RNAV autorizada?

In this glossary, Aproximação RNAV autorizada refers to: An instruction indicating that the aircraft is authorized to execute an RNAV approach.

How is Aproximação RNAV autorizada used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Piloto, você está autorizado a aproximação RNAV pista um seis."
